# CANDIDATE: TRAILING_PROFIT_LOCK_20PCT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current fixed profit-lock (+5% arm, +10% stop) clips winners prematurely during strong trends, reducing edge capture on J winner days. A trailing profit-lock (chandelier-style) that trails the high-water mark by 20% would allow winners to run further while still protecting gains, increasing edge capture on winner days without significantly increasing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged. Exit logic: 
- Profit-lock arms when premium reaches +5% of entry premium.
- Once armed, the profit-stop is set to max(arm_floor, high_water_mark × (1 - trail_pct)), where trail_pct=0.20.
- The chart stop (primary invalidation) and time stop (15:50 ET) remain unchanged.
- The premium stop (catastrophe cap) remains at -50% for Safe and -7%/-5% for Bold.

2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use 16 months of data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward OOS; selection method is automated grinder; overfit risk mitigated by layered gates (WF≥0.70, real-fills <±20% on top 3 J days, concentration disclosure)

5. **Failure modes:**

   - Max drawdown: potential increase if trailing stop fails to protect during sudden reversals
   - Blow-up scenario: volatile market with frequent 5%+ retraces triggering stop and missing resumption of trend
6. **Concentration:** TBD after Stage-1; will disclose top-5 days % of P&L
